result.name: Dvije Obale — Mon Ami kao tiskani list
result.oneLiner: A broadsheet, not a brochure: warm paper, a Didone masthead, one claret hairline running the length of the page — and Mon Ami's own black-plate photography set into it like plates onto linen.
result.rationale: Mon Ami has three things almost no Croatian restaurant has and its current site wastes all three: a founding story that is literally a map (Božo from Skradin, Barica from Turopolje — the Adriatic and the continent married in one kitchen since 1997), forty professional 1920×1080 originals shot on black reflective surfaces of which half have never been published, and a stack of genuine, checkable recognitions (MICHELIN Selected 2026, Gault&Millau 13,5/20 with two toques, Restaurant Croatica, 23 appearances in Croatia's top 100). Quiet luxury here is not a mood board — it is the only honest response to that material. So the page is built as a printed editorial feature: a paper ground, a Bodoni masthead set before any photograph appears, a single 1px hairline at the 5/12 column split that runs the whole document and physically divides "more" from "kopno", and awards rendered as letterspaced type rather than borrowed logos. The restraint also solves their real problems. A typographic awards band cannot misuse the MICHELIN mark. A per-day hours table kills the sentence that sends people to a locked door on Monday night. A subgrid-aligned HTML menu with a visible "po kg" badge turns €96 from alarming into transparent. And because their photography is already shot against near-black, dark mode is not an inversion trick — it is the dining room at 21:00, and their own images sit in it better than they sit on white.

palette.use: Primary page ground. Warm bone, never pure white — reads as uncoated stock, not a browser default. Also the ground for the menu, story and visit sections.
Secondary ground for the stat row, capacity table, menu category rail and the white card that overlaps the wine photograph. One step down, never a border.
Every 1px rule on paper: the persistent column rule, dish-row separators, leader dots, masthead underline, award column dividers.
All display and body type on paper (14:1). Also the full-bleed ground for the awards band, the daily-catch section and the footer.
Secondary copy: English dish names, captions, eyebrows, roles, the masthead metadata line. Measured at 4.6:1 on paper so it passes 1.4.3 at body size.

The single accent, derived from their existing #b22047 but dropped in lightness and chroma until it stops shouting. Prices, links, the Rezerviraj border, today's highlighted hours row, the 120px rule under the masthead. 8.3:1 on paper.
Hover/active state on paper (via color-mix in oklch) and the dark-mode replacement for claret, where it holds 4.8:1 on the charcoal ground.

Skradin olive-oil gold. Decorative only on paper — fails contrast as text, so it is used strictly for the rule and the numeral in the 'Vlastito' section. In dark mode it is promoted to a text colour (8:1 on charcoal).
Dark-mode ground. Warm charcoal matched to the black reflective surfaces in their own food photography, so images blend into the page instead of floating on it.
Dark-mode type. Slightly warm, never #FFF — keeps Bodoni's hairlines from vibrating on the dark ground.
Dark-mode rules and dividers. Sits at 3.1:1 against night so it still satisfies 1.4.11 as a non-text boundary.

typography.displayFont: Bodoni Moda — variable, opsz 6–96, weights 400 and 500 only (never 600+). Subsets: latin, latin-ext (mandatory for č ć đ š ž). Loaded as: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bodoni+Moda:opsz,wght@6..96,400;6..96,500&display=swap
typography.bodyFont: Instrument Sans — variable, weights 400, 500, 600. Subsets: latin, latin-ext. Loaded in the same css2 request: family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600. Uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for all prices, capacities and times.
typography.pairingRationale: Bodoni Moda is a true optical-size Didone, so the masthead at 132px can use opsz 96 (razor hairlines, tight joins) while a 24px caption uses opsz 24 and keeps its stems — one family covering the whole editorial range without ever looking like scaled-up body text. That optical axis is exactly what separates this from a 2019 Playfair page. Its coastal-Italian register earns the €€€ band and the Michelin listing without a single ornament. Instrument Sans is the counterweight: a low-contrast, slightly humanist grotesque with an unfussy single-storey g and genuinely good latin-ext diacritics, so 'Škampi na buzaru' and 'Vukomeričke gorice' set cleanly at 13px. Hard rules: Bodoni is never used below 20px and never for running copy; Instrument Sans is never used above 34px. In dark mode Bodoni display switches from weight 400 to 500 to compensate for the optical thinning of light-on-dark hairlines. Both faces get a size-adjust fallback @font-face (Georgia for Bodoni, system-ui for Instrument) generated with Fontaine, not guessed, to hold CLS near zero.
typography.scale:
Viewport range 360px (22.5rem) → 1440px (90rem). Every preferred value carries a rem term so browser text-zoom still scales at 200% (Roselli's rule — never a bare vw).
--step-h1 (masthead, 44→132px): clamp(2.75rem, 0.92rem + 8.15vw, 8.25rem); line-height 0.92; letter-spacing -0.02em
--step-h2 (section heads + pull quotes, 32→68px): clamp(2rem, 1.25rem + 3.33vw, 4.25rem); line-height 1.04; letter-spacing -0.015em
--step-h3 (sub-heads, names, 24→34px): clamp(1.5rem, 1.29rem + 0.93vw, 2.125rem); line-height 1.15
--step-lead (intro paragraphs, 21→27px): clamp(1.3125rem, 1.19rem + 0.56vw, 1.6875rem); line-height 1.5
--step-body (17→19px): clamp(1.0625rem, 1.02rem + 0.19vw, 1.1875rem); line-height 1.62; max-width 62ch
--step-small (captions, English dish names, 14→15px): clamp(0.875rem, 0.85rem + 0.09vw, 0.9375rem); line-height 1.45
--step-eyebrow (letterspaced caps, 12→13px): clamp(0.75rem, 0.73rem + 0.09vw, 0.8125rem); letter-spacing 0.22em; text-transform uppercase
All h1/h2/h3 get text-wrap: balance; all p get text-wrap: pretty (fails safe in Firefox, no @supports needed).

sections.title: Masthead / sticky navigacija
sections.purpose: Fix the four things their current header does not do: say what day it is, say whether they are open, let you book, and let you switch language.
sections.layout: position: sticky; inset-block-start: 0; z-index: 90. Height 4.5rem ≥64rem, 3.5rem below. Ground: color-mix(in oklch, var(--paper) 82%, transparent) with backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.1) and the -webkit- prefix; 1px hairline on the block-end. Three-zone grid (auto 1fr auto). Left: the plate-O roundel at 28px + 'MON AMI' in Bodoni 500 / 18px / tracking 0.14em. Centre (≥64rem only): five links — Priča, Jelovnik, Vlastito, Prostor, Posjet — Instrument Sans 600 / --step-eyebrow; underline is a registered @property --rule-sweep <percentage> animated 0%→100% over 180ms. Right: a live state chip ('Danas otvoreno do 23:00' / 'Danas zatvoreno · otvaramo u utorak u 11:00') computed in JS from Europe/Zagreb, marked aria-live="polite"; a HR|EN toggle; and 'Rezerviraj' — a 40px-tall, 0-radius button with a 1px claret border that opens the <dialog>. Below 64rem the centre links move into a popover sheet opened by a 44×44 text button labelled 'Izbornik' (never icon-only). :root gets scroll-padding-block-start: 5.5rem so anchor jumps and keyboard focus clear the bar (WCAG 2.4.11, technique C43).
sections.copyDirection: Nav labels are single Croatian words, no articles: Priča · Jelovnik · Vlastito · Prostor · Posjet. The state chip is the only sentence and it must be unambiguous: 'Danas otvoreno do 23:00', 'Danas do 16:30', 'Danas zatvoreno · otvaramo u utorak u 11:00'. Button reads 'Rezerviraj', not 'Rezervacije'.

sections.title: Hero — masthead prije fotografije
sections.purpose: Invert the restaurant-site cliché: type first, photograph second. Establish 29 years and the guide listings inside the first screen without a scrim over a face.
sections.layout: Block A (paper, ~34vh, no image): 'MON AMI' centred at --step-h1 in Bodoni 400/opsz 96; beneath it a 120px × 1px claret rule; beneath that 'RESTORAN · VELIKA GORICA · OD 1997.' at --step-eyebrow in stone. Block B: full-bleed image, height min(72vh, 780px), object-fit: cover, object-position: center 42% — use gallery/21.jpg (beef carpaccio, rocket, pink peppercorns on black), the strongest editorial frame in the library. This is the LCP element: served as <picture> AVIF/WebP/JPEG, width/height set, loading="eager", fetchpriority="high" (the only image on the page that gets it), with a matching <link rel="preload" as="image" type="image/avif" fetchpriority="high">. Never lazy. Bottom-left of the image, on a linear-gradient scrim from oklch(0.19 0.008 55 / 0.65) to transparent: two typographic lockups side by side in --step-eyebrow white — 'MICHELIN GUIDE HRVATSKA · 2026 · SELECTED' and 'GAULT&MILLAU · 13,5/20 · DVIJE KAPE'. No logos, no star device.
sections.copyDirection: No welcome sentence, no 'dobrodošli'. The masthead line does all the work. The two award lockups are set as plain factual strings — 'Selected', never 'zvjezdica'. Below 48rem the two lockups stack and the image crops to 4:5.

sections.title: Uvodna izjava
sections.purpose: Give the page its one quotable line — their own best sentence, which currently sits buried on /o-nama/.
sections.layout: Centred single column, grid-column 3 / 11, max-width 62ch, padding-block 18vh clamp(4rem, 10vh, 9rem). The verbatim line set as a two-to-three-line display quote in Bodoni 400 at --step-h2 with text-wrap: balance. Beneath: a 48px claret rule and 'Mon Ami · od 1997.' in --step-eyebrow. Then a three-up stat row on paper-inset, each cell a subgrid so numeral and label align exactly: numerals in Bodoni 400 at 3.5rem, labels in --step-eyebrow stone. Cells: '29 godina' / 'obiteljski vođen restoran', '70 mjesta' / 'plus separe za 10 i terasa za 20', '3×' / 'svježa riba stiže tjedno'. Vertical hairlines between cells on ≥48rem; stacked with horizontal hairlines below.
sections.copyDirection: Use the sentence exactly as they wrote it: 'Neka Vaša nepca dožive jedinstveni gastronomski užitak mediteranskih specijaliteta u srcu Turopolja.' Do not rewrite it, do not shorten it. The stat labels are lowercase sentence fragments, not headlines. Confirm the 29 with Bruno before it is set in 3.5rem type — one source says 1994.

sections.title: Priznanja — potpuno tipografska traka
sections.purpose: Prove the standing without borrowing a single trademarked mark, and without an aggregateRating that would disqualify the page from rich results anyway.
sections.layout: Full-bleed band on --ink, min-height 42vh, no images at all. Four columns ≥64rem (2×2 below), separated by 1px --night-hairline verticals. Each column: year in --step-eyebrow oil-gold, then one line in Bodoni 500 at --step-h3 in --night-ink, then one caption line in --step-small at 70% opacity. Columns: '2026 / MICHELIN Guide Hrvatska / Selected — preporuka, bez zvjezdice'; '2026 / Gault&Millau 13,5/20 / dvije kape · Chef's Restaurant'; '2024 / Restaurant Croatica / među 100 vodećih hrvatskih restorana'; '1999.–2025. / 23 puta / na listi 100 najboljih u Hrvatskoj'. Below the four, a single centred line of --step-small: their own sentence about the most important recommendation.
sections.copyDirection: Precision is the whole point here. 'Selected' is spelled out and glossed as 'preporuka, bez zvjezdice' — that honesty is more impressive than the fudge. Do not claim a consecutive-year count; the sources contradict each other. Close with the verbatim: '…a naša najvažnija preporuka su naši gosti.'

sections.title: Dvije obale — priča od 1997.
sections.purpose: Tell the founding story as geography, not as a wall of text. This is the section that makes the site about THIS restaurant and no other.
sections.layout: The persistent 1px hairline at the 5/12 boundary becomes structural here. Left (grid-column 1 / 5, position: sticky, top: 7rem): eyebrow 'MORE', then the portrait-orientation gallery/30.jpg (chef holding a whole octopus, ~675×1200 — the only vertical frame in the library, use it where verticality is an asset) at 3:4, then a 4-line caption about Skradin, Božo, oblica olives. Right (grid-column 7 / 13, scrolls past it): eyebrow 'KOPNO', a --step-h2 heading, four body paragraphs, and an inline timeline of four dated rows separated by hairlines — 1997. osnutak · 2008. Goran Marko Beus preuzima kuhinju · 2018. prva MICHELIN preporuka · 2026. MICHELIN Selected i Gault&Millau 13,5/20. The two columns then resolve into one full-bleed 21:9 image (gallery/33.jpg, the scorpionfish-into-the-pot diptych) followed by Bruno's quote centred in Bodoni at --step-h2. Below 64rem: stacks, sticky removed, hairline hidden.
sections.copyDirection: Lead with the collision, not the founding date: a Dalmatian who married a Turopoljka and put fish on a menu in a town that ate grilled meat. Use Bruno verbatim — 'dvije kuhinje pod istim krovom, onu mediteransku i kontinentalnu' and 'prava mala revolucija'. Keep it to roughly 180 Croatian words plus the timeline. Never write 'tradicija duga 25 godina' again.

sections.title: Dnevni ulov
sections.purpose: Turn the most anxiety-inducing thing on their menu — €96 with no unit — into the most trustworthy thing on the page.
sections.layout: Full-bleed --ink section. Left (grid-column 1 / 6): gallery/05.jpg (whole bream, dentex, red mullet, langoustines on a white platter) bleeding off the viewport's left edge, revealed by a clip-path inset animation on a view() timeline. Right (grid-column 7 / 13): --step-h2 heading in --night-ink, two short paragraphs, then the species list as a two-column typographic list with 1px --night-hairline separators — each row is the Croatian name in Instrument Sans 500 at --step-body with the English beneath in --step-small at 60% opacity: škrpina / scorpionfish, brancin / sea bass, kovač / John Dory, zubatac / dentex, crna orada / black sea bream, sabljarka / swordfish, kvarnerski škampi / Kvarner langoustines, jastog / lobster. Closing line set apart in oil-gold above a hairline.
sections.copyDirection: State the logistics plainly because they are the proof: fish arrives three times a week from several fishermen, because the boats do not sail every day. Then the honest line that fixes everything: 'Ribu iz vitrine vagamo pred vama. Cijena se određuje po kilogramu i mijenja se s ulovom.' Add the small print: 'Vrste ovise o danu — pitajte osoblje što je jutros stiglo.'

sections.title: Jelovnik
sections.purpose: Give them the thing their website has never had — a real, indexable, priced HTML menu — and give it the typographic discipline of a wine list.
sections.layout: Paper ground, full width. A sticky category rail at inset-block-start: 4.5rem (directly under the masthead): nine 40px-tall chips, scroll-snap-type: x proximity, each ≥24×24 target with 8px spacing. Content renders from a single JS array declared at the top of the file. Per section: <ol> with grid-template-columns: [name] minmax(0,1fr) [lead] auto [price] 7ch; each <li> is display: grid; grid-template-columns: subgrid; grid-column: 1 / -1 — so dish name, leader and price align across every row in the section regardless of description length. Name: Instrument Sans 500 / --step-body / ink. English beneath: --step-small / stone. Leader cell: a 1px repeating-linear-gradient dot row, align-self: end. Price: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, claret, text-align: end, format '26,50 €'. Badges after the name: 'bez glutena', 'vegetarijansko', 'preporuka šefa', 'po kg' — --step-eyebrow at 11px in a 1px hairline pill, 4px radius, always with text, never icon-only. Each <section> gets content-visibility: auto; contain-intrinsic-size: auto 900px. Sections: Hladna predjela, Topla predjela i rižota, Jela od riba, Jela od mesa, Prilozi, Salate, Slastice, Bez glutena, Vegetarijansko. A separate Vinska karta block closes it: 60 etiketa, the house cuvée Chardonnay-Graševina from Vukomeričke gorice, sommelier Zlatko Šimac, and a tel: link — because the list genuinely is not published and pretending otherwise would be worse.
sections.copyDirection: Croatian dish name is primary and authoritative; the English line beneath must be rewritten from scratch (their current platform translations read 'Prshutto', 'cackerels', 'french frie', and 'Beefsteak salad' for a truffle pasta). Four honest footnotes under the list: 'Posljednje ažuriranje: [datum].' · 'Cijene su u eurima i mogu se promijeniti.' · 'Oznaka po kg odnosi se na ribu i školjke koje se vagaju.' · 'Za alergene pitajte osoblje — vodimo evidenciju svih 14 skupina.' Feature the four the house itself flags: Carpacio od tune s crnim tartufom, Crni rižoto od sipe, Beefsteak u umaku od tartufa, Losos sa žara.

sections.title: Vlastito — ulje, tartuf, vino
sections.purpose: The three things they make or source themselves. This is where a good restaurant becomes a specific one.
sections.layout: Three asymmetric editorial panels, deliberately unequal, the claret hairline threading through all three. Panel 1 (grid-column 1 / 8): gallery/14.jpg — oil poured from a dark amphora beside a lobster and a scorpionfish — bleeding off the left edge, text block right. Panel 2 (grid-column 6 / 13, margin-block-start: -8rem so it overlaps panel 1 across the column rule): no photograph at all, because none exists — instead a paper-inset block with the word 'TARTUF' set in Bodoni at --step-h1 in oil-gold at 18% opacity as a background layer, copy on top. Absence handled as composition rather than filled with stock. Panel 3 (full 12 cols): onama1.jpg (sommelier before the wine wall) at 21:9, with a paper card overlapping its lower-left at inset-block-end: -3rem carrying the wine copy.
sections.copyDirection: Oil: their own grove in Skradin, oblica, bottled as Ekstra Djevičansko Maslinovo Ulje, gold medal at Dani mladih maslinovih ulja in Vodice with 96,42 boda. Say it is sold to guests. Truffle: fresh native black Turopolje truffle, served daily year-round, grated at the table over the tuna carpaccio; note guests can order a day ahead and grate it themselves. Wine: 60 etiketa, mostly Croatian producers, plus their own cuvée. Critical attribution rule: these three belong to the restaurant, never to MICHELIN — MICHELIN has never mentioned the oil or the wine.

sections.title: Ljudi
sections.purpose: Put a face on a 29-year family business that currently names one person in one sentence and shows nobody.
sections.layout: Deliberately unequal sizing rather than a three-card row. Chef large (grid-column 1 / 7, 3:4). Bruno medium (grid-column 8 / 11, 3:4, offset margin-block-start: 6rem). Team wide (grid-column 1 / 13, 21:9, below both). Each caption block: name in Bodoni 400 at --step-h3, role in --step-eyebrow stone, then one quote in Bodoni 400 at --step-lead with a 32px claret rule above it. Portraits get a subtle filter: saturate(0.94) so the three sources match tonally.
sections.copyDirection: Chef: 'Goran Marko Beus · šef kuhinje od 2008.' — born in Split, career on the Dalmatian coast and on ships. Quote: 'Ne znaš tko ti sjedi za stolom.' Bruno: 'Bruno Ceronja · vlasnik i domaćin' — quote: 'Sve što može biti lokalno koristimo u kuhinji.' Team strip caption names the sommelier, Zlatko Šimac, and the roughly ten people in the kitchen. Settle the chef's name form with him first — MICHELIN and Gault&Millau disagree.

sections.title: Prostor i događanja
sections.purpose: Answer the practical questions a wedding, a communion or a closed business lunch actually asks, which the current site never states in one place.
sections.layout: Full-bleed gallery/01.jpg (the empty room — pendant lamps, oak beams, grey leather chairs) at 21:9. Beneath, on paper: a three-column capacity table built on subgrid so the numerals align — 'Glavna dvorana / 70 mjesta', 'Separe / 10 mjesta · zatvoreni sastanci', 'Natkrivena terasa / 20 mjesta · grijana'. Then events as a single hairline-separated list, one per row, each row a flex with the label left and a one-line note right: poslovna druženja, svadbe, pričesti, krizme, krštenja, tematske večere. Right-aligned at the end: a secondary button 'Upit za događanje' opening the same <dialog> with the 'Događanje' radio preselected. A second smaller image (onama2.jpg — the full room in service, waiter in white gloves, guests toasting) sits at grid-column 7 / 13 beside the list, because an empty room sells the design and a full room sells the dinner.
sections.copyDirection: Use their own line about natural materials verbatim: 'Interijer je sadržan od prirodnih materijala koji predstavljaju naš pristup življenju i poslovanju.' Be explicit about the constraint rather than hiding it: 'Za veće grupe i svadbe javite se najmanje tjedan dana unaprijed — restoran prima do 70 gostiju u dvorani.' State no pets and no smoking here, once, quietly.

sections.title: Galerija
sections.purpose: Publish the twenty photographs that have existed on their server for years and never appeared on a page — and give every one of them the alt text and caption the current gallery lacks entirely.
sections.layout: Not a 40-thumb paginated grid. A curated editorial sequence of seven frames in a 12-column grid-auto-flow: dense layout with deliberately varied spans and aspect ratios: [7 cols 3:2] [5 cols 4:5] / [12 cols 21:9] / [4 / 4 / 4 cols, all 1:1] / [6 cols 4:5] [6 cols 3:2]. Suggested sequence from the unpublished set: 28 (fish on the charcoal grill), 25 (chef plating octopus), 37 (live blue lobster close-up), 18 (rolled veal on black), 03 (the oil bottles against brick), 12 (grilled squid platter in white gloves), 40 (chocolate torte with ice cream). Every image lazy-loaded, decoding="async", inside content-visibility: auto. Each gets a real Croatian caption in --step-small stone beneath, plus descriptive alt. A single text link closes the section rather than pagination.
sections.copyDirection: Captions are factual and specific, not poetic: 'Riba na žaru na drveni ugljen', 'Hobotnica se raspoređuje na tanjur', 'Živi jastog iz vitrine', 'Naše maslinovo ulje iz Skradina'. Alt text describes the photograph for someone who cannot see it, and is different from the caption. Closing link: 'Pogledajte svih 40 fotografija'. Credit the photographers once, in --step-eyebrow: 'Fotografije: Josip Škof, Mario Žilec, Jakob Goldstein.'

sections.title: Posjet — radno vrijeme, adresa, dolazak
sections.purpose: Fix the single most damaging failure on the current site: hours that exist on exactly one page, phrased in a way that sends people to a closed door on Monday evening.
sections.layout: Two columns on paper. Left (grid-column 1 / 7): a real <table> of hours, one row per day, hairline-separated, times in tabular-nums — Ponedjeljak 11:00–16:30 / Utorak–Subota 11:00–23:00 / Nedjelja zatvoreno / Blagdani zatvoreno. Today's row gets a claret left border, paper-inset ground, aria-current="date", and a 'danas' tag; the row and the masthead chip read from one JS function so they can never disagree. Below: address as selectable text, both numbers as tel: links (+385 1 6213 333 and 091 5444 715), email. Right (grid-column 8 / 13): getting here as four hairline-separated rows — zračna luka (bus every 35 min to the main station, 3 min walk, ~2 €), auto (parking nearby), autobus 290 iz Zagreba, gradski romobili (Bolt). No Google Maps iframe: a static map still in AVIF with a 'Otvori u Google Kartama' text link — better LCP, no third-party cookies on load. Closing the section, full width: a claret 'Rezerviraj stol' button at 56px and beside it 'Nazovi 01 6213 333'.
sections.copyDirection: Never reuse the sentence '11:00 – 23:00 svaki dan osim nedjelje i blagdana' — the table replaces it. Be explicit that booking is by phone or form because there is no live system: 'Rezervacije primamo telefonom i putem obrasca. Za veće grupe javite se ranije.' Confirm the rumoured 1–21 August annual closure with the owner before publishing it — it is a single unverified source.

sections.title: Rezervacija — modalni obrazac
sections.purpose: Give a 70-seat restaurant that hosts weddings a booking route that is not 'read a phone number off a page', without buying a widget the owner will never maintain.
sections.layout: A native <dialog> opened with showModal() — focus trapping and inertness come free, which a popover would not give. Width min(36rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)), paper ground, 0 radius, 1px hairline border, no shadow. Backdrop: oklch(0.19 0.008 55 / 0.45) with backdrop-filter: blur(6px). Fields on a two-column subgrid collapsing to one below 30rem: ime i prezime, telefon (type=tel), e-mail, datum (type=date, min=today), vrijeme (select of 30-min slots generated from the real day's hours so Monday never offers 19:00), broj osoba (1–20, with a note above 10), a radio group Ručak / Večera / Događanje, and a napomena textarea with field-sizing: content. Submit posts to a simple form endpoint with a mailto: fallback. The phone number sits permanently beside the submit button, never hidden behind it. Focus returns to the triggering button on close.
sections.copyDirection: Header: 'Rezervirajte stol'. Under it, one sentence of expectation-setting: 'Javit ćemo vam se telefonom radi potvrde — obično isti dan.' Note above 10 guests: 'Za više od 10 osoba nazovite nas — dogovorit ćemo separe ili dvoranu.' Placeholder for napomena names the cases widgets handle badly: 'alergije, bezglutenska jela, dječja stolica, poslovni sastanak'. Croatian date and time formatting throughout.

sections.title: Podnožje
sections.purpose: Stop the site signalling abandonment the way 'Copyright © 2020' currently does, and carry the structured data.
sections.layout: Full-bleed --ink. Four columns ≥64rem: (1) the roundel mark + 'MON AMI · RESTORAN' + 'Trg kralja Tomislava 26, 10410 Velika Gorica'; (2) contact — both tel: links, email, 'Rezervacije telefonom'; (3) hours, condensed to three lines; (4) Facebook and Instagram as text links plus the HR|EN toggle repeated. Hairline above a bottom bar carrying the year (rendered from JS so it can never freeze again) and a Pravila o kolačićima link. Below the footer, the JSON-LD: @type Restaurant, name, address, geo 45.71137 / 16.07998 (five decimals, as Google requires), telephone, url, servesCuisine 'Mediterranean, Seafood', priceRange '€€€', acceptsReservations true, menu pointing at #jelovnik, and openingHoursSpecification as four entries — Monday 11:00:00/16:30:00, Tuesday–Saturday 11:00:00/23:00:00, Sunday 00:00:00/00:00:00. Deliberately NO aggregateRating: self-serving ratings on a LocalBusiness make the page ineligible for star results anyway.
sections.copyDirection: Footer copy is addresses and numbers only — no marketing sentence. The one editorial permission: the house motto, set small and centred above the bottom rule, 'Kao prijatelj prijatelju.' Set lang correctly on <html> (hr, switching to en with the toggle) — the current site declares en-US over Croatian text.

signatureMoves: The 'dvije obale' rule: one 1px hairline, position: fixed at the 5/12 column boundary, running the entire document at z-index 0. In the story section it literally divides more (left, sticky) from kopno (right, scrolling); elsewhere it is just the page's spine. Hidden below 64rem. One line of CSS that makes the whole layout feel like a printed object rather than a stack of cards.

Type before photograph. The first 34vh of the page is bare paper with MON AMI set at 132px Bodoni and nothing else — the hero image only begins below it. Every competitor in this category opens with a photograph under a scrim; opening with a masthead is what makes it read as a magazine rather than a restaurant template.

The live 'Danas' state, computed once and rendered twice. A single JS function reading Europe/Zagreb drives both the masthead chip and the highlighted row in the hours table, so they can never contradict each other — and it directly repairs the site's single most damaging bug, the Monday-evening closed door.

Prices as a wine list, not as cards. grid-template-columns: subgrid on every dish row means name, leader dots and price align across an entire menu section regardless of how long each description runs. Paired with a 'po kg' hairline pill that turns €96,00 from alarming into transparent.

Awards rendered entirely in letterspaced type on a full-bleed ink band — no MICHELIN device, no Gault&Millau toque graphic, no TripAdvisor owl. 'Selected' is even glossed as 'preporuka, bez zvjezdice'. Legally bulletproof, and the restraint reads as more confident than any badge.

Absence as composition. There is no photograph of the Turopolje truffle anywhere in their asset library, so that panel has no image at all — instead the word TARTUF is set at 132px Bodoni in olive-gold at 18% opacity behind the copy. The gap in the archive becomes the most striking panel on the page.

A curated seven from the twenty that have never been published. Images 21–40 have sat on their server for years, invisible. The gallery is a sequence, not a grid dump — and every frame finally gets alt text.
motion: Language toggle via the View Transitions API: document.startViewTransition() wraps the HR↔EN textContent swap, with view-transition-name set on the hero masthead, the section headings and the menu list so text cross-fades over 220ms instead of snapping. 91.75% support (Firefox 144+); where unsupported it degrades to an instant swap, which is the correct fallback. Guard with `if (document.startViewTransition)`.

Reservation dialog entry with @starting-style + transition-behavior: allow-discrete on both display AND overlay — the overlay entry is what stops the top-layer element vanishing instantly on exit. Opacity 0→1 and translateY(12px)→0 over 240ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); backdrop fades transparent→oklch(0.19 0.008 55 / 0.45) with backdrop-filter blurring 0→6px.

Scroll-driven hairline draw: section rules animate transform: scaleX(0)→1 with transform-origin: left on animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 10% cover 30%. CRITICAL: scroll-driven animations are NOT Baseline — Firefox still ships them behind layout.css.scroll-driven-animations.enabled (BCD lists version_added as the literal string 'preview'). So the base rule is scaleX(1) and the whole block lives inside @supports (animation-timeline: view()), never the reverse. Remember animation-duration is ignored on view() timelines — range does the work.

Image un-crop on the same guarded view() timeline: clip-path animates inset(0 0 8% 0) → inset(0 0 0 0) over animation-range: entry 15% cover 45%. Applied to the daily-catch photograph and the three Vlastito panels. Base state is the uncropped inset(0), so Firefox users simply see the finished image.

Hero cinematic drift: object-position moves center 42% → center 48% across the hero's own view() range — a 6% shift, not parallax. Slow enough to read as a camera settling rather than a scroll gimmick, and it dies gracefully where view() is unsupported.

Nav underline via a registered custom property: @property --rule-sweep { syntax: '<percentage>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0% } driving a linear-gradient background-size on the link. Gradients cannot be transitioned directly; the registered property is what makes the 180ms sweep possible. @property is at 95% support — the highest of any modern feature used here.

Menu category rail: position: sticky under the masthead with scroll-snap-type: x proximity on the chip row, and :has(:target) on each menu section to tint its own sticky sub-header in claret when linked to. No JS scroll spy.

Everything above sits inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). With reduced motion requested, all transitions collapse to 0.01ms, view() blocks are skipped, and startViewTransition is not called — the page is fully functional and visually identical at rest.
result.darkMode: Dark mode here is not an inversion — it is the same restaurant at 21:00, and it is arguably the more native mode for this brand because their own hero photography is shot on black reflective surfaces. On :root, `color-scheme: light dark` is declared (mandatory, or light-dark() silently does nothing) and every token is written once as `light-dark(paper, night)` — ground #FAF7F1 → #232019, type #2C2723 → #EBE6DE, hairline #DDD6CC → #443E38. Two colours change role rather than value: claret lifts from oklch(0.42 0.13 14) to oklch(0.62 0.15 16) to hold 4.8:1 on charcoal, and olive-gold is promoted from decoration-only to a legitimate text colour (2.2:1 on paper, 8:1 on night) — so the Vlastito section's gold headings only exist in dark mode. Three further adjustments, because a straight token swap is what makes dark modes look cheap: (1) Bodoni display switches from weight 400 to 500, compensating for the optical thinning of light-on-dark hairlines; (2) photographs get filter: brightness(0.93) saturate(0.96) so the black-plate food shots sit *in* the page rather than glowing out of it; (3) the two sections that are already ink-on-dark in light mode — Priznanja and Dnevni ulov — invert to paper in dark mode, so the page keeps its editorial rhythm of alternating grounds instead of flattening into one long dark scroll. Control is a three-state segmented toggle in the footer (Auto / Svijetlo / Tamno) writing to localStorage and setting a data-theme attribute on <html>; `color-scheme: only light` / `only dark` is set from that attribute so form controls, scrollbars and the date picker follow. Default is Auto. An inline blocking script in <head> reads localStorage before first paint to avoid a flash. prefers-contrast: more raises hairlines to --ink/--night-ink and drops the backdrop-filter on the masthead so the sticky bar becomes fully opaque.
risks: PHOTOGRAPHY RIGHTS ARE THE WHOLE CONCEPT'S LOAD-BEARING WALL. The layout depends on large, editorial, self-owned imagery. Only monami.hr's own 40 gallery originals and /uploads files are plausibly usable, and even those are credited to Josip Škof, Mario Žilec and Jakob Goldstein 'on behalf of Mon Ami' — publicly reachable is not the same as cleared. The MICHELIN CDN, Gault&Millau, PutniKofer and Eat Out Zagreb images are all third-party licensed and must not be hotlinked or copied. Get written clearance from all three photographers before build, or the concept degrades to a materially weaker image set.

THERE IS NO EXTERIOR PHOTOGRAPH ANYWHERE. Not of the building, the entrance, the signage or the terrace — I could not find one on their server or any third-party source. The Posjet section and the social share card both want one. Budget a half-day shoot, or the 'arrive here' beat has no image and the OG card falls back to a food shot.

THE 29 IS NOT FULLY SAFE. Almost every source says 1997, but a 2020 Kronike Velike Gorice piece says the family restaurant opened in 1994. Setting a number in 132px Bodoni on the masthead makes it the most conspicuous claim on the site. Confirm with Bruno before build; if unresolved, the masthead reads 'OD 1997.' and the stat cell is dropped rather than guessed.

MICHELIN WORDING AND MARKS. The page must say 'MICHELIN Guide Hrvatska 2026 · Selected' and never imply a star, a Bib Gourmand or a Green Star (the guide's own dataLayer records distinction=plate, greenstar=False, award_type=false). Do not reproduce the star or Bib devices. Separately, MICHELIN's JSON-LD wrongly records acceptsReservations: 'No' — do not mirror that value, and note their inspector's salmon-teriyaki dish does not appear on the restaurant's own published menu, so verify before featuring it.

THE MENU WILL ROT. This owner's site has had zero blog posts since 2020, a copyright frozen at 2020 and no content change in roughly two years. Publishing 60+ priced dishes creates a maintenance obligation they have never met, and prices have already drifted hard (carpaccio €16→€18,50, scampi €80→€96/kg). Mitigate structurally: all menu data in one clearly commented JS array at the top of the file, a visible 'Posljednje ažuriranje' date, and an explicit 'cijene se mogu promijeniti' line. Also agree who updates it — the current site is authored entirely by an external contractor account, 'mpecko'.

BODONI HAIRLINES ARE FRAGILE. At small sizes and light-on-dark they thin toward failing 1.4.3, and the optical-size axis will not save a 14px caption. Enforce the rules in code review: Bodoni never below 20px, never used for running copy, weight 500 not 400 in dark mode. If a client stakeholder pushes Bodoni into body text the design fails accessibility, not just taste.

THE LOGO IS A PROBLEM AND THE OWNER MAY NOT SEE IT. The file in their header, sp.png, is a 115-byte transparent spacer containing no artwork; the real logo-monami.png is a 576×298 raster on a cream wood-grain ground with no transparency and no vector original. My recommendation is to keep the plate-O roundel as a small standalone mark and set MON AMI in Bodoni — which means the wordmark and the site's display face will not match the old logo. That is a brand conversation to have before build, not after.

PERFORMANCE VS. THE ASSET LIBRARY. Their images are 500KB–1.5MB unoptimised JPEGs with no WebP or AVIF anywhere. A single self-contained HTML file is fine, but the images are remote and must be pre-processed to AVIF/WebP at three widths before launch or LCP will fail on mobile CrUX regardless of how clean the code is. One fetchpriority="high" preload on the hero only; everything else lazy with content-visibility: auto.

THE EN TOGGLE IS NOT SEO. A JS textContent swap gives visitors English but gives Google nothing — there is no second URL to point hreflang at. If English search visibility matters (airport traffic, MICHELIN readers arriving from an English-only listing), the toggle needs to set a ?lang=en parameter with reciprocal hreflang link tags and a self-canonical per version. Flag this as a scope decision rather than assuming it away.

UNVERIFIED FACTS THAT MUST BE CONFIRMED BEFORE PUBLISHING: the rumoured 1–21 August annual closure (single source, absent from their own site); parking specifics (the numbers '5' and '15' on okusi.hr are unlabelled); the exact chef name form (their site says Goran Marko Beus, Gault&Millau says Marko Beus); whether the Restaumatic online ordering is still live; and the correct Instagram handle (@monami.hr and @restoranmonami both appear across sources).
